info.name: Worldline Card Issuing Account - AccountState Payment API
Get payment based on payment id

params.name: acquirerId
params.description: Unique identification of the acquirer, determined by equensWorldline

params.name: paymentId
params.description: Unique identification of the payment in which this transac   tion has been paid out

params.name: paymentDate
params.description: Payment Date (yyyy-mm-dd), known as payment posting date

items.docs: This operation uses the unique acquirerId and payment id to retrieve the payment data

params.name: acquirerId
params.description: Unique identification of the acquirer, determined by equensWorldline

params.name: iban
params.description:
Iban

paymentReference or Iban must be present

params.name: paymentReference
params.description:
Merchant payment identification information; a static number frequently used to indicate store location associated with a payment

paymentReference or Iban must be present

params.name: startDate
params.description: Payment start Date (yyyy-mm-dd)

params.name: endDate
params.description: Payment end Date (yyyy-mm-dd)

params.name: merchantPaymentAmountFrom
params.description: Payment amount (whole units), amount should be greater than or equal to this value

params.name: merchantPaymentAmountTo
params.description: Payment amount (whole units), amount should be less than this value

params.name: merchantPaymentAmountCurrency
params.description: Merchant payment amount currency, according to ISO 4217. Required if search amount is available. Example EUR

params.name: sortField
params.description: Sort field

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Page size (max 300)

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number

items.docs:
This operation uses the unique acquirerId and IBAN or paymentReference to retrieve all the associated payment(s)

If there is a previous and/or next page the http response header will have a link (url) to this data
